name: number-field
title: Number field
description: A number in a field frame with stepper key cells and a unit cell: Base UI NumberField (locale parsing, hold-to-repeat, min/max) inside a Field.
whenToUse: Use it to enter a number with step buttons and a unit. For a value on a scale dragged by hand use Slider.

parts.name: NumberField
parts.description: A number in a field frame, with stepper cells, built from the parts above. - Arrow Up/Down step, Shift+Arrow takes `largeStep`, Alt+Arrow `smallStep`, Page Up/Down the large step, Home/End jump to min/max. Typing is parsed in the field's locale; the value commits on blur or Enter. - The steppers are not in the Tab order (Base UI): the input is the one stop, the keys do the stepping. - It is a Base UI Field: a Form collects the value under `name`, and `validate`, `invalid` and the Form's `errors` print under the frame.

props.name: layout
props.description: control: its own 2px frame. cell: a cell of an enclosing frame (no border, label visually hidden).

props.name: steppers
props.description: Stepper cells (− and +). Off for a field where stepping makes no sense (an order number, a postcode is not a number field at all).

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit printed in an affix cell after the number, in the Code voice ("kg", "%", "pallets").

parts.name: NumberFieldDecrement
parts.description: The − key cell. Base UI repeats while held and disables it at `min`; it is not in the Tab order.

parts.name: NumberFieldGroup
parts.description: The frame of cells: the attention cell (inserted at its start, open while the field is invalid), then its children. `layout="cell"`: the frame is a cell of an enclosing frame (no border of its own).

parts.name: NumberFieldIncrement
parts.description: The + key cell. Base UI repeats while held and disables it at `max`; it is not in the Tab order.

parts.name: NumberFieldInput
parts.description: The input cell: end-aligned with tabular figures, so the digits stay put while the value steps. A number keeps its sign where it belongs in RTL ("-18", not "18-"): the text is laid out as its own paragraph while the alignment still follows the page.

parts.name: NumberFieldRoot
parts.description: Base UI's NumberField.Root: value, `min`/`max`, `step` (`largeStep`, `smallStep`), `format` and `locale` (Intl.NumberFormat), hold-to-repeat, form value (`name`). `onValueChange` gets Base UI's event details last.

parts.name: NumberFieldUnit
parts.description: The unit cell after the input, in the Code voice ("kg", "%", "pallets"). It is a label, not part of the value; the seam between it and the input is the soft one, so the two read as one value. Its content is isolated, so a unit led by a neutral character ("°C") keeps its order in RTL.
